Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Message ID
Fields.Description: Subtitle text for this line. Body Type B shows the next text ID (Message ID + 1). The conversation continues with the next row ID until a row is missing.

Fields.Name: Timeout
Fields.Description: Seconds the line stays up. Below 0: the default talk timeout from GameSystemCommonParam. The longer of this and the time the talk script asks for is used. Retail −1 on every row.
Appears unused by the game. Retail −1 on every row.
Appears unused by the game. Retail −1 on every row.
Appears unused by the game. Retail −1, 9991/9992 on two rows.
Appears unused by the game. Retail −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Redirect Talk ID
Fields.Description: Talk ID to start from instead of this row while Redirect Event Flag ID is on; the redirected row is checked again. Retail 0 on every row (never used, Redirect Event Flag ID is −1).
Appears unused by the game. Retail −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Redirect Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: When this event flag is on, the conversation starts from Redirect Talk ID instead. −1: no redirect. Retail −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Force Display
Fields.Description: Passed to the subtitle as its force-display flag. Retail: never set.

Fields.Name: Player Talk Target
Fields.Description: Who the player faces while this line plays: 0 the player, 1-8 participant 1-8 (1 is the main speaker), 9 and 10 no target. Retail 1 on most rows, 10 on 17 rows.

Fields.Name: Player Talk Script Value A
Fields.Description: Value given to the player's behaviour script while this line plays. Its use in the script is not established. Retail 0 except 1 on one row.

Fields.Name: Player Talk Script Value B
Fields.Description: Second value given to the player's behaviour script while this line plays. Its use in the script is not established. Retail 0 on every row.
